title: How LLMs Are Persuaded: A Few Attention Heads, Rerouted

summary.claim: LLMs switch away from a correct answer under persuasion because of a few mid-layer decision heads: shallow heads read persuasive keywords and write an option-routing feature that redirects decision-head attention to the persuasion target.
summary.condition: Controlled multiple-choice tasks, four open-source model families, a GEO-based source-selection task; mitigated with a low-rank update to the decision heads' key projections.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Limited to multiple choice; whether the same circuit drives free-form answers or multi-turn user pushback is open.
